scope: CPU EAM and SW+LJ same-input LAMMPS comparison; many-body kernel OpenMP and arithmetic optimization
build: Release AppleClang 21, -O3 -march=native, OpenMP; same compiler and flags for LAMMPS
order_per_sample: Current ATV, LAMMPS, saved baseline ATV; sequential, no task build/test concurrent

eam.geometry: FCC Cu, 14 cells/axis, a=3.61 Angstrom, deterministic 0.001*a distortion
eam.potential: Sutton-Chen Cu; in-tree EAMPotential functions; shifted pair term
eam.oracle_representation: setfl sampled from the same analytic functions: dr=0.0001 Angstrom, nrho=200001, drho=0.005, nr=55001. Unused r<1 Angstrom regularized. ATV analytic; LAMMPS cubic interpolation.

sw-lj.geometry: diamond Si, 11 cells/axis, a=5.43 Angstrom, deterministic 0.001*a distortion
sw-lj.potential: Original Stillinger-Weber Si plus shifted LJ epsilon=0.01 eV, sigma=2 Angstrom; benchmark composition, not a fitted silicon model
sw-lj.oracle_style: hybrid/overlay sw lj/cut (OMP suffix for threads>1)
sw-lj.oracle_representation: same in-tree SW parameter row exported to .sw; all analytic

limitations: Shared desktop, not an isolated machine. No compiler processes active at start, but load and wall variability remain; every sample is retained.

EAM uses the same physical parameters with analytic ATV versus tabulated/interpolated LAMMPS functions. Strict measured initial force/energy errors bound the interpolation difference; this is not identical kernel representation.
SW+LJ remains slower than LAMMPS at the measured multithread points; this artifact does not claim backend-wide performance parity.
The frozen contracts binary was copied before later unrelated optimizer/PW/DIIS edits. Its exact hashes identify the measured build; those edits do not affect these many-body kernels.

Baseline/current loop ratios include this wave's Runtime contract changes as well as many-body kernels. Separate Pair timings are retained; no numerical-load sampling was run concurrently with wall measurements.
No long-trajectory, pressure-value, or larger-system performance equivalence is claimed.

profile_before_optimization.source: native MD timing report plus macOS sample; separate diagnostic runs
profile_before_optimization.eam_sampling: About 600 of 1204 production samples were inside pow or its stub. General real powers were replaced by integer multiplication and pair phi reused.
profile_before_optimization.sw_sampling: SW dominated Pair time; short true-cutoff neighbor traversal and thread-private force buffers follow LAMMPS OPENMP.

reproduction.atv: mpiexec -n RANKS <frozen-binary> SIDE 20 200 THREADS PREFIX MODEL
reproduction.lammps: mpiexec -n RANKS lmp -in benchmarks/lj/in.cpu -var MODEL eam|swlj -var PREFIX PREFIX -var WARM 20 -var STEPS 200 -log PREFIX.lmp.log -screen none; add -sf omp -pk omp THREADS for THREADS>1
reproduction.validation: python3 benchmarks/lj/compare.py PREFIX; for short checks use side6/warm0/steps1 and additionally --stage final --force-atol 1e-8
